products.name: Boracef Ceftriaxone for Injection
products.shortDescription: Prescription injectable cephalosporin antibiotic for clinician-directed hospital and clinical therapy.
products.description: Boracef Ceftriaxone is a broad-spectrum, third-generation bactericidal cephalosporin antibiotic formulated for intravenous administration. Indicated for severe, susceptible systemic bacterial infections under trained clinician administration.
products.useCase: For clinical management of severe respiratory, urinary tract, intra-abdominal, and septic bacterial infections. For I.V. use only; requires professional reconstitution.
products.regulatoryInfo: NAFDAC Reg. No: B4-1435. Marketed by Vitborah Pharmaceutical Company Ltd.

products.name: Boraflox 500 Ciprofloxacin Tablets
products.shortDescription: High-potency fluoroquinolone antibiotic for confirmed susceptible bacterial infections.
products.description: Boraflox 500 contains ciprofloxacin hydrochloride, providing bactericidal activity by inhibiting bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV. Prescribed in accordance with clinical culture and sensitivity guidelines.
products.useCase: Prescription antibiotic for susceptible urinary, respiratory, skin and gastrointestinal bacterial infections in adult patients under medical direction.

products.name: Artborah Tablets
products.shortDescription: First-line Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) for uncomplicated malaria.
products.description: Artborah is a fixed-dose oral antimalarial combination therapy designed to rapidly clear Plasmodium falciparum parasites and prevent recrudescence, aligning with WHO malaria treatment guidelines.
products.useCase: Treatment of acute, uncomplicated malaria infections caused by Plasmodium falciparum in adults and children under medical guidance.

products.name: Vitboter Artemether Injection
products.shortDescription: Injectable antimalarial for healthcare facility emergency administration.
products.description: Vitboter Artemether is a lipid-soluble artemisinin derivative for intramuscular injection in emergency clinical settings where oral therapy cannot be tolerated.
products.useCase: Clinician-directed emergency treatment of severe malaria or when patients are vomiting and unable to take oral ACT medication.

products.name: Staxim 500 Cefuroxime Axetil Tablets
products.shortDescription: Broad-spectrum cephalosporin for respiratory, ENT, and soft tissue infections.
products.description: Staxim 500 contains cefuroxime axetil, an oral prodrug that is hydrolyzed to cefuroxime, exerting bactericidal action against a wide spectrum of Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens.
products.useCase: Indicated for upper and lower respiratory tract infections, otitis media, tonsillitis, and uncomplicated urinary tract infections.

products.name: Oral Rehydration Salts (W.H.O. Recommended ORS)
products.activeIngredients: Sodium chloride 2.60 g, potassium chloride 1.50 g, sodium citrate 2.90 g, anhydrous glucose 13.50 g per sachet
products.shortDescription: WHO-standard oral electrolyte and fluid replacement formula with pleasant orange flavour.
products.description: Vitborah W.H.O. Recommended ORS restores essential electrolytes and fluid balance lost through acute diarrhoeal illness, vomiting, intense perspiration, and heat exhaustion in pediatric and adult patients.
products.useCase: Fast oral rehydration therapy for children, infants, and adults suffering dehydration from gastrointestinal illness.

products.name: Vitbonac 50 Diclofenac Potassium Tablets
products.shortDescription: Rapid-acting analgesic and anti-inflammatory formulation for acute pain relief.
products.description: Vitbonac provides rapid analgesic action via diclofenac potassium, which exhibits faster absorption than the sodium salt, effectively reducing prostaglandin synthesis in acute painful conditions.
products.useCase: Short-term relief of acute pain and inflammatory episodes, including post-traumatic pain, dental pain, dysmenorrhoea, and musculoskeletal flare-ups.

products.name: Vitborah Timolol Eye Drops BP 0.5%
products.shortDescription: Ophthalmic solution for lowering elevated intraocular pressure in glaucoma management.
products.description: Vitborah Timolol Eye Drops 0.5% is a sterile ophthalmic solution that effectively reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing aqueous humor formation in ocular hypertension and open-angle glaucoma.
products.useCase: Prescription ocular care to control elevated intraocular pressure in patients with chronic open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension under ophthalmological care.

products.name: Vitborah Ceftriaxon 1g Injection
products.activeIngredients: Ceftriaxone (as sodium salt) 1 g per vial
products.description: Sterile injectable third-generation cephalosporin designed for institutional clinical care. Effective against extended-spectrum bacterial pathogens when administered under medical surveillance.
products.useCase: For inpatient management of severe systemic infections, surgical prophylaxis, and acute pulmonary or meningeal infections.

products.name: Venita Gentamycin Injection B.P.
products.shortDescription: Potent aminoglycoside for targeted, serious Gram-negative bacterial infections.
products.description: Venita Gentamycin Injection provides potent bactericidal activity against susceptible aerobic Gram-negative bacilli. Must be administered under strict professional monitoring for renal and vestibular parameters.
products.useCase: Hospital-based treatment of serious hospital-acquired infections, septicaemia, and complex urinary or pelvic infections.

products.name: Vicocin Lincomycin 500mg Capsules
products.shortDescription: Lincosamide antibiotic indicated for penicillin-allergic patients with susceptible infections.
products.description: Vicocin contains lincomycin hydrochloride, offering targeted antibacterial coverage against Gram-positive staphylococci and streptococci for patients who cannot receive penicillins.
products.useCase: Oral prescription therapy for skin, bone, joint, and respiratory infections caused by susceptible organisms.

products.name: Venicin Griseofulvin 500mg Tablets
products.shortDescription: Systemic oral antifungal agent for persistent dermatophyte ringworm infections.
products.description: Venicin is an oral antifungal antibiotic that binds to keratin in newly formed skin, hair, and nails, rendering them resistant to fungal invasion by Trichophyton and Microsporum species.
products.useCase: Treatment of dermatophyte infections of the scalp (tinea capitis), body (tinea corporis), and feet (tinea pedis) when topical therapy is insufficient.

products.name: Levotreat Levofloxacin 500mg Tablets
products.shortDescription: Broad-spectrum oral fluoroquinolone for severe bacterial pulmonary and urinary conditions.
products.description: Levotreat is an advanced fluoroquinolone antibiotic with enhanced Gram-positive and atypical pathogen coverage, prescribed in accordance with strict clinical antibiotic stewardship.
products.useCase: Specialized prescription therapy for complicated urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, and acute bacterial sinusitis.

products.name: Vitborah Vitamin B-Complex Injection
products.activeIngredients: Balanced Vitamin B-complex sterile parenteral solution
products.shortDescription: Parenteral vitamin B formulation for rapid restorative nutritional therapy.
products.description: Vitborah Vitamin B-Complex Injection provides sterile, bioavailable B-vitamins for patients experiencing severe malabsorption, post-operative debility, or acute deficiency states under clinical guidance.
products.useCase: Hospital-administered therapy for severe metabolic depletion, neuropathy management, and intensive nutritional support.

products.name: Apricona Fluconazole 150mg Tablets
products.shortDescription: Single-dose or short-course triazole antifungal for candidiasis and fungal infections.
products.description: Apricona contains fluconazole, a synthetic triazole antifungal agent that inhibits fungal cytochrome P-450 sterol C-14 alpha-demethylation, stopping fungal cell membrane synthesis.
products.useCase: Clinician-recommended treatment for vaginal candidiasis, mucosal fungal infections, and systemic candida conditions.

products.name: Appedor Nutritional Appetite Syrup
products.shortDescription: Syrup formulation supporting appetite stimulation and restorative convalescent nutrition.
products.description: Appedor Syrup combines essential amino acids and B-vitamins with cyproheptadine to assist patients recovering from prolonged illness who experience poor appetite and debility.
products.useCase: For medically supervised convalescent support in patients suffering from appetite loss and convalescent wasting.

products.name: Vibiron Hematinic & Nutritional Syrup
products.activeIngredients: Ferrous iron, B-Complex Vitamins, and Zinc
products.shortDescription: Fortified hematinic syrup providing essential iron, zinc, and B-vitamins for blood formation.
products.description: Vibiron Syrup delivers well-tolerated oral iron fortified with zinc and essential B-complex cofactors to support healthy hemoglobin synthesis, red blood cell formation, and overall vitality.
products.useCase: Nutritional replenishment for individuals with high iron demands, during pregnancy (under medical guidance), convalescence, or inadequate dietary intake.
